tweet.text:
Barack Obama.

Great speaker. Very charismatic. Appoints the CrowdStrike guy right before the big ‘hack.’ Real leadership. The kind of guy who says ‘Yes we can’… and then apparently ‘Yes we can rig it and blame the bears.’

Hillary Clinton. Tough lady. Perkins Coie is her law firm. They hire CrowdStrike. The emails get leaked showing the primaries were rigged. And then the Russia story drops. It’s like she looked at the bag and said, ‘This is leaking… quick, throw it at Russia!’ Classic Hillary. Always thinking three steps ahead… or at least three emails ahead.

James Comey. FBI Director. Never seizes the servers. Just takes CrowdStrike’s word. You know, the same way I’d trust a fox to count the chickens. ‘How many chickens do we have left, Mr. Fox?’ ‘All of them. Why do you ask?’ Real thorough investigation.

Julian Assange. Offers a $20,000 reward, hints about a 27-year-old DNC worker shot in the back on Dutch TV, then refuses to elucidate. You know, like a guy who knows exactly what happened but doesn’t want to ruin the surprise ending. Real team player.

And poor Seth Rich.

Nice kid.

Walks home with the truth.
Ends up on the sidewalk.
Nothing stolen.

They turn the whole thing into a conspiracy theory so nobody has to look at the screen they’re all staring at. It’s like the dog ate the homework… and then the dog got shot… and then they blamed Russia.

They farmed you with the Russia hoax. Ancient families, modern puppets, Plato’s Cave but with better Wi-Fi and worse comedy. The screen shows you the nice clean spear story — Russia hacked us, heroes investigated, THOK! Case closed.

Follow the Bag
